entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I've actually been thinking a bit about[n]my actions this time...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I was way too worried about who I am,[n]and how I don't compare to the other[n]members of our group.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Turns out I just don't have any guts, huh?
It's okay.
It happens to everyone.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, I've known you long enough.[n]No need to be modest.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Thanks.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I think the reason I was so hung up on[n]wanting to be human is because I needed[n]a goal of my own.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, not a goal per se, but something[n]bigger... I guess more like... a reason to[n]live.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But now that I'm sure I belong with the[n]Phantom Thieves, I know what I want[n]to do. Do you know what it is?
Make us more famous?
Get your own room?
I don't know.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What else, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That too, eventually.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm going to do whatever I can to make[n]sure the Phantom Thieves succeed.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: In other words, our goals are in[n]alignment.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: From now on, I'm not going to hold[n]anything back.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You'd better put some effort in too![n]Don't make me regret my choice!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Plus... I want Lady Ann to be happy.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If my actions can help her achieve[n]happiness, that's more than enough[n]for me...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I hope you're not thinking about[n]how sappy all of this is!
I feel like my bond with Morgana[n]is growing deeper...
